label: Show this window
description: Ask the platform to reveal the existing window, keeping its document owner.

label: Add layer
description: Add a layer on top (or above another). Give it a medium (see media) to paint in oil or watercolour; without one it holds crisp vector art.

params.name: id
params.description: An id to address the layer by (`sky`); one is made when absent.

params.name: medium
params.description: A medium id (`oil`, `watercolour`, … see `media`) to paint this layer's marks with; absent or empty for plain vector art.

params.name: above
params.description: Put the new layer directly above this layer instead of on top.

params.name: texture
params.description: `0..=1`: let the ground's tooth show through the layer's marks.

label: Align marks
description: Align marks or groups to an edge or centre line, and/or distribute them with equal gaps, within their own extent, the artwork or another mark.

params.name: to
params.description: `artwork` or a mark/group id; else their extent.

label: Apply Artwork edit
description: One edit as a typed JSON value: {action: id, ...its params}. The named action does the same and says more.

oneOf.description: A field edit, as the field-edit action takes it
A named action: `action` is its id, `args` its parameters

at.description: When the action was authored, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

label: Arrange marks
description: Bring marks to the front or back of their layer, one step forward or backward, or directly above or below another mark or group.

params.name: of
params.description: The mark or group `above` and `below` are relative to.

label: Draw chart
description: Bar chart from numbers; use it, not hand-computed rects. Equal bars, one baseline, lengths exactly value/max of box.

params.name: box
params.description: Bars' area x, y, w, h on its bottom (hbar: left).

label: Checkpoint
description: Name the current version, to restore or compare with later.

label: Combine shapes
description: Combine shapes into one path mark, in the bottom one's place and style.

label: Compare with reference
description: Compare with reference. See the artwork beside (or over, or minus) the reference picture, with a difference score (mean colour distance 0..1 in the reference's frame; lower is closer) and the regions that differ most, to iterate toward it.

params.name: region
params.description: `[x, y, width, height]`; the reference's frame when absent.

params.name: mode
params.description: `side-by-side` (default; the artwork left, the reference right), `overlay` (the reference at half strength over the artwork) or `difference` (bright where they differ).

params.name: size
params.description: Longest side of each picture, 64 to 1024 (default 640).

label: Compare versions
description: Compare versions. Compare two versions: marks and layers added, removed or changed by id (with what changed: stacking, shape, fill, …), the changed region, and with look a before|after picture of it.

params.name: from
params.description: The earlier version: a change id from history or a checkpoint name.

params.name: look
params.description: Also a picture of the changed region: before left, after right.

label: Compare versions
description: List the items that differ between two versions.

params.name: from
params.description: A change id from history, or a checkpoint name

label: Draw shapes
description: Draw shapes on a layer in one step: rect, ellipse, polygon, line, path (SVG d), text, stroke or image (src: a file path, content address or data: URI; a unit per pixel unless sized), each with fill, gradient, stroke and opacity. Answers the new ids; or give your own. On a painted layer filled shapes are laid in with the brush: paint a building or small figure as filled planes (lit and shadow side) with a small brush, not as many strokes.

params.name: layer
params.description: The layer to draw on; the top layer when absent.

pixelated.description: Images: preserve hard pixel edges when enlarged.

id.description: An id to address the mark by later (`sun`, `hill-2`); one is made when absent.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned rectangle; `radius` rounds its corners.
An open polyline through `points`, drawn with the stroke colour.

font.description: `sans`, `serif`, `mono` or a family `media` lists under fonts.

weight.description: 100 to 900; 400 regular, 700 bold, any value between.

tracking.description: Letter spacing in thousandths of the size: 80 opens up capitals, negative tightens.

path.description: SVG path data the baseline follows instead of starting at x, y; align sets the words at its start, middle or end.

oneOf.description: Text, first baseline at `y`; `\n` breaks lines.
A brush stroke as `paint` lays one: a smooth curve through `points` (`[x, y]` or `[x, y, pressure]`), `size` wide; forks, dabs and hatch as there.

src.description: File path, content address or `data:` URI.

width.description: Units; absent: a unit per pixel, or the other side's aspect.

crop.description: Fractions `[x, y, w, h]` of the picture shown.

oneOf.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP in the frame `x, y, width, height`.

shape.description: The geometry: `{"kind": "rect", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 10, "height": 10}`, `ellipse` (cx, cy, rx, ry), `polygon`/`line` (points), `path` (d: SVG path data), `text` (x, y, text, size) or `stroke` (points, size).

stops.description: Colour stops: `[[0, "#ffd27a"], [1, "#e0603a"]]`; a stop's alpha (`#ffd27a00`) fades the paint out, for a glow or mist.

focal.description: Radial only: where the light sits inside the circle, off its centre.

gradient.description: Instead of `fill`; on an oil layer the brush is remixed along it.

brush_size.description: Painted layers: the brush size a filled shape is laid in with.

brush.description: A stroke's brush preset, as `paint` takes it.

angle.description: Painted layers: the brushwork's direction in degrees.

wet.description: Painted layers: paint into what is still wet.

shadow.description: A soft shadow cast by a mark.

inner_shadow.description: As shadow, inside the mark from its edge; light colour = highlight.

feather.description: Soften the edge outward over this many units.

group.description: A group id: edits naming it change the members as one; `a/b` nests group b in a.

clip.description: Cut to this mark's or group's shape (opacity 0 hides it), to `selection` (its area now) or to an area's SVG path data.

transform.description: An affine `[a, b, c, d, e, f]` on the geometry, as `inspect` shows.

label: Edit layer
description: Rename or place a layer in an organisational folder (group; empty removes it), change its medium, opacity, visibility, lock or adjustments (grading all its marks), or move it to the front, back, forward or backward.

params.name: group
params.description: Organisational folder name; empty removes the layer from its folder. Consecutive members are presented together without changing stacking.

params.name: medium
params.description: A medium id, or empty for plain vector art.

params.name: locked
params.description: Locked marks are not picked by the pointer.

params.name: texture
params.description: `0..=1`: let the ground's tooth show through the layer's marks.

params.name: adjust
params.description: Colour and tone of all on it, as `edit-marks` adjust; `{}` clears.

params.name: mask
params.description: `reveal`, `hide` or `remove`: a mask layer `<id>-mask` to paint greys on, white shows, black hides; `unlink` keeps it put as the layer's marks move (`link` again).

label: Edit marks
description: Change marks by id: colours, opacity, name, `move_by` `[dx,dy]`, scale, rotate and flip about their centre, or move them to another layer. Strokes: re-brush (brush, size, params), smooth, simplify, extend, split at a point, merge. Pictures: crop, straighten, adjust (exposure, white balance, …; look to judge).

params.name: pixelated
params.description: Images: preserve hard pixel edges when enlarged.

params.name: shape
params.description: Replace the geometry: a shape as `draw` takes it (e.g. a path's new `d`).

params.name: shadow
params.description: As draw's; zero offset and blur removes it.

params.name: inner_shadow
params.description: As draw's; zero offset and blur removes it.

params.name: group
params.description: Put into this group (`a/b` nests b in a); empty takes out of any.

params.name: clip
params.description: Cut to this mark's or group's shape, `selection` or an area's SVG path data; empty uncuts.

params.name: brush_size
params.description: Painted layers: the brush size a filled shape is laid in with.

params.name: scale
params.description: Scale about each mark's or group's centre.

params.name: layer
params.description: Move the marks onto this layer, on top.

params.name: transform
params.description: An affine `[a, b, c, d, e, f]` in artwork units applied after the rest, to all the marks as one: a stretch or turn about any point.

params.name: crop
params.description: Images: fractions `[x, y, w, h]` of the picture to show (it stays put); `[]` all of it.

params.name: straighten
params.description: Images: degrees, -45 to 45, to level it.

params.name: adjust
params.description: Colour and tone; given steps replace, `{}` clears.

exposure.description: Stops, -5 to 5. Others -1 to 1 unless noted.

curve.description: Tone curve `[[in, out], …]`, 0-1; `[[0.05, 0], [0.95, 1]]` sets black and white points.

params.name: smooth
params.description: Strokes: take the wobble out of their paths, 0..=1.

params.name: simplify
params.description: Strokes: drop points within this many units of the line.

params.name: extend
params.description: A stroke: continue it through these points, from the end they start nearer.

params.name: split
params.description: A stroke: cut it in two at the point nearest x, y; the far part gets a new id.

params.name: merge
params.description: Strokes: join them, in the order named, into the first.

label: Export picture
description: Export picture. Render the artwork at full size (or scaled) as a PNG, JPEG or WebP, written to path or kept as content.

params.name: transparent
params.description: Omit the artwork ground for a transparent PNG or WebP.

params.name: path
params.description: An absolute `.png`, `.jpg` or `.webp` path to write it to.

label: Export SVG
description: Export SVG. Export the artwork as SVG (plain layers as exact vectors, painted ones as pictures), written to path or kept as content (small ones answered).

params.name: ids
params.description: Only these marks or groups, cropped to them and without the ground: one icon of a set.

params.name: outline_text
params.description: Write text as outlines, which look the same without its fonts. Text along a path is always outlined.

params.name: path
params.description: An absolute `.svg` path to write it to.

label: Edit a Artwork field
description: Change one field: {path: [{field: name} | {item: id} | {key: k} | {cell: {row, column}}], op: set | splice | replace | add | insert | remove | ..., ...its arguments}. Address a collection's items by what they hold, never by position: {path: [{field: name}], op: "upsert-item", match: {field: value}, value: {fields}} updates the one item that matches, else appends one; insert-item and move-to place by at: "end" | {after: id} | {before: id}.

params.name: edit
params.description: The path of the field from the record's root, and the operation

schema.description:
A field edit: `path` from the record (fields by name, items by id, map entries by key) and `op` with its arguments. Editable paths:
- `title`: set, splice, replace — Title (string)
- `width`: set — Width (number)
- `height`: set — Height (number)
- `ground`: set — Ground
- `layers`: upsert-item, insert-item, remove-item, move-to, set — Bottom to top; removing an item asks nothing; Undo takes it back
- `layers.*`: set — Bottom to top; one item, by its id
- `layers.*.name`: set, splice, replace — Name (string)
- `layers.*.group`: set, splice, replace — Organisational folder; empty for an ungrouped layer. It does not (string)
- `layers.*.medium`: set, splice, replace — The medium preset that paints this layer's marks, or empty for plain (string)
- `layers.*.opacity`: set — Opacity (number)
- `layers.*.visible`: set — Visible (boolean)
- `layers.*.texture`: set — `0..=1`: how much of the ground's tooth shows through the layer's (number)
- `layers.*.locked`: set — Held still: the pointer passes through its marks to those beneath (boolean)
- `layers.*.adjust`: set — Colour and tone adjustments of everything on the layer
- `layers.*.base`: set — A mask's grey before any mark, `0..=1`: 1 shows all of its layer, (number)
- `layers.*.invert`: set — A mask that hides where it is light and shows where it is dark (boolean)
- `layers.*.clip`: set — Clipped to the layer below: it shows only where that layer has paint (boolean)
- `layers.*.unlinked`: set — A mask that stays put when its layer's marks move. Linked, it moves (boolean)
- `marks`: upsert-item, insert-item, remove-item, move-to, set — Bottom to top within each layer, layers bottom to top (see; removing an item asks nothing; Undo takes it back
- `marks.*`: set — Bottom to top within each layer, layers bottom to top (see; one item, by its id
- `marks.*.layer`: set, splice, replace — Layer (string)
- `marks.*.name`: set, splice, replace — Name (string)
- `marks.*.shape`: set — Shape
- `marks.*.style`: set — Style
- `marks.*.transform`: set — An affine transform `[a, b, c, d, e, f]` applied to the geometry (array or null)
- `marks.*.group`: set, splice, replace — The group the mark belongs to, or empty (string)
- `marks.*.clip`: set, splice, replace — The mark whose shape this mark is cut to, or empty (string)
- `media`: set, remove-key — Media presets saved in this artwork, by id
- `media.*`: set, splice, replace, add, insert, remove — Media presets saved in this artwork, by id; an entry, by its key, and what is inside it
- `reference`: set — Reference
- `selection`: set — Selection

label: Find image area
description: Find image area. Select what a picture of the artwork shows: the magic wand (at: colour touching it), a colour everywhere (colour), a photo's subject (subject: true) or the selected edge refined (refine: units), as one undo step. Then use-selection fill, mask or clear. Accepts select's add/subtract/intersect, layer and feather options. The artwork must remain unchanged while the area is found.

params.name: subject
params.description: Find the main subject on-device; with at, the object there.

params.name: refine
params.description: Edge reach in artwork units; subject defaults to 6 image pixels.

params.name: at
params.description: `[x, y]` in artwork units: alone, the magic wand (like colour touching it); with subject, the object there.

params.name: tolerance
params.description: How far a colour may stray for at or colour, 0..1 (default 0.15).

params.name: layer
params.description: Find on this layer alone; otherwise use all visible layers.

label: Apply several Artwork edits as one
description: Several actions as one all-or-nothing step: one undo, and if any member refuses nothing is applied. actions: [{action: id, args: {..}}].

params.name: actions
params.description: Artwork actions to apply in order as one step, each {"action": id, "args": {..}}

oneOf.description: A named action, args as it takes them

action.description: One action value, as the `apply` action's `apply` parameter describes it

label: History
description: List the versions, oldest first: change id (what undo to, restore and diff take), action and its arguments, run, author, time, undone, checkpoints.

label: Import SVG
description: Import an SVG (markup, file path or content address) as one draw of path and text marks in a group: fills, gradients, outlines, opacity, blends and clip paths.

params.name: svg
params.description: SVG markup, an absolute path to a `.svg`, or a content address.

params.name: layer
params.description: The layer to draw on; the top layer when absent.

params.name: group
params.description: The group the marks join (one is made when absent).

params.name: fit
params.description: Fit into `[x, y, width, height]`, aspect kept; own size otherwise.

label: Inspect marks
description: Inspect marks. List layers and newest marks (ids, bounds, colours), scoped by region/layer. palette: true also counts literal fill, stroke and gradient colours across all matching marks, independent of limit (first 32 colours, `palette_colours` is the total). Named pigments come from media. measure weighs ink to balance icons and type.

params.name: palette
params.description: Include literal fill, stroke and gradient colours with mark counts, scoped by region/layer, independent of the newest-mark limit.

params.name: region
params.description: Only marks touching `[x, y, width, height]`.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many of the newest matching marks to list, 0 to 400 (default 100).

params.name: version
params.description: A past version: a change id from history or a checkpoint name.

params.name: full
params.description: Also each mark's shape, style and transform, to edit exactly.

label: Look at the artwork
description: Look at the artwork. See the artwork as a picture: the whole of it, or a region up close. Answers with the image and the revision it shows. grid: true overlays labelled coordinates for placing marks.

params.name: region
params.description: `[x, y, width, height]` in artwork units; the whole artwork when absent. A small region is a close look at detail.

params.name: size
params.description: The longest side of the picture in pixels, 64 to 1536 (default 768).

params.name: grid
params.description: Draw a labelled coordinate grid over the picture, to place marks.

params.name: version
params.description: A past version: a change id from history or a checkpoint name.

params.name: reference
params.description: Show the reference picture over the artwork; as set when absent.

label: Measure ink
description: Measure ink. Weigh how marks or groups put down ink, as the eye sees it: each one's ink box, ink area, centre of mass and its offset from the box's middle (two icons balance when areas and offsets match), and a text's letter boxes. Answers once their pictures are rendered.

params.name: version
params.description: A past version: a change id from history or a checkpoint name.

label: List media
description: List media. List the media layers can use (oil, watercolour presets and those saved here) with their engines' parameters and pigment palettes, and the fonts text can use.

label: New artwork
description: Start a blank artwork (one undo away). size: screen, a4, letter, square, poster, icon (landscape turns it). start: paper, white, watercolour, oil, panel, dark.

params.name: size
params.description: A size preset; `width` and `height` override it.

params.name: landscape
params.description: Turn the size on its side.

params.name: start
params.description: A ground and first medium; the fields below override it.

params.name: medium
params.description: The first layer's medium; empty for plain.

label: Open artwork
description: Replace the artwork with a saved .artwork file (path, content address or JSON), one undo away.

params.name: file
params.description: A `.artwork` path, a content address, or the file's JSON.

label: Open picture
description: Open a PNG, JPEG or WebP as a new artwork the size of the picture (a unit per pixel), the picture its first mark, `picture`. Replaces what the artwork held (undo brings it back).

params.name: path
params.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP: an absolute path, a content address or a data: URI.

params.name: title
params.description: The new artwork's title; the file's name when absent.

label: Paint strokes
description: Paint brush strokes on a layer in one step. On an oil or watercolour layer the medium simulates real paint; on a plain layer the brush preset draws them: pen for clean line art (pressure swells the line), pencil or charcoal to shade (pressure sets darkness; charcoal catches the paper), marker for flat see-through tone, airbrush for soft glows, calligraphy for lettering. brush eraser (no colour) clears paint under it on its layer; remove-marks along takes whole strokes. Each stroke: points `[[x,y] or [x,y,pressure]]`, size, colour (#rrggbb or `pigment:<name>`). Answers the new ids. One stroke can be many: forks grows a branch or bare tree; dabs scatters foliage, flowers or (with `dab_length`, angle -90) grass; hatch shades the area its points enclose. Work like a painter, looking close after each passage: big shapes first; then forms in a few values (dark mass, middle, lit side); small lights and accents last.

params.name: layer
params.description: The layer to paint on; the top layer when absent.

points.description: `[[x, y], …]` or `[[x, y, pressure], …]`, pressure `0..=1`; the stroke is smoothed through them, so a few points make a curve.

brush.description: Plain layers: `pen` (crisp ink, pressure sets width), `pencil` (grainy, pressure sets darkness), `marker` (flat, overlaps darken), `airbrush` (soft spray that builds up), `charcoal` (picks up the ground's tooth), `calligraphy` (broad nib at `angle`, default 45). Any layer: `eraser` clears paint beneath it on its layer. A round ink brush when absent. Plain layers: `pixel` and `pixel-eraser` paint or clear whole square cells, ignoring pressure and taper.

wet.description: Paint into what is still wet: blends in oil, bleeds in watercolour.

params.description: Medium overrides on a painted layer (`{"load": 0.2}` for dry brush); on a plain layer the brush's flow, hardness, spacing, smoothing and taper, each 0..=1.

forks.description: A limb that lifts to a point and forks this many times (1-6) into ever thinner twigs: a branch or a bare tree in one stroke.

spread.description: With `forks`: how widely the twigs splay, in degrees (default 35).

dabs.description: Instead of one line, this many short dabs (1-600) of `size` scattered along the points: foliage, flowers, broken light.

scatter.description: With `dabs`: how far they stray either side of the path, in units (default twice `size`).

dab_length.description: With `dabs`: how long each is, in units (about `size` when absent); much longer than `size`, each is a flick lifting to a point (grass).

hatch.description: Instead of one line, lines this many units apart across the area the points enclose: shading in one stroke; another at a second angle cross-hatches.

angle.description: With `dabs`, the way they point in degrees (-90 is up; along the path when absent); with `hatch`, the lines' (default 45).

clip.description: Keep the paint inside this mark's shape, as a painter cuts in against an edge: texture a rock or a crown within its silhouette. Or `selection` (its area now), or an area's SVG path data.

params.name: group
params.description: Put them in this group, to edit or remove them as one.

label: Redo
description: Bring back what your last undo took back.

label: Remove layer
description: Remove a layer and every mark on it.

label: Remove marks
description: Remove marks by id, every mark of a layer, or the strokes a path along crosses.

params.name: layer
params.description: Remove every mark on this layer (with along: only its strokes).

params.name: along
params.description: Remove the brush strokes this path `[[x, y], …]` crosses, as a stroke eraser does.

label: Remove medium
description: Remove a medium saved in this artwork.

label: See the app
description: See the app's window as a picture: answers with the image and the revision of the document it shows.

params.name: version
params.description: A past version: change id from history, or checkpoint name

label: Restore version
description: Bring the document back to a version as a new change, or only the items named by ids.

params.name: version
params.description: A change id from history, or a checkpoint name

label: Restore reviewed items
description: Restore precisely the reviewed paths as a new undoable change, only if the live causal frontier still matches. Empty selection never restores everything.

label: Review restoration
description: Review exact-item restoration without writing. Returns pinned target and live heads; copy review into restore-reviewed. Any later edit requires a new review.

params.name: version
params.description: A change id, causal frontier, or checkpoint

params.name: paths
params.description: Exact differing paths from diff; a root selects its entire value

label: Save artwork
description: Save artwork. Save the artwork as a .artwork file open-artwork reads: to a path, or kept as content.

params.name: path
params.description: An absolute `.artwork` path to write; else kept as content.

label: Save medium
description: Save a medium preset in the artwork: an engine (oil or watercolour) with parameters, a ground and a pigment palette. Layers can then use its id.

params.name: medium
params.description: A medium: one of the built-in engines with its parameters, a suggested ground and a palette. Saving one makes it part of the artwork, shared with everyone who opens it.
Engine parameters by id; `media` lists each engine's parameters and ranges.

ground.description: The ground this medium suits: `smooth`, `paper`, `cold-press`, `rough`, `linen` or `panel`.

name.description: Lowercase words joined by `-`, such as `burnt-sienna`.

granulation.description: Watercolour: how much it settles into the paper's tooth, `0..=1`.

items.description: A pigment in a medium's palette, used as `pigment:<name>`.

label: Select area
description: Select an area: shapes or marks; add, subtract, intersect, grow, feather, invert. For the magic wand, a colour, the subject or edge refinement invoke find-area (a job, as it reads a picture). Then use-selection, or clip: "selection" in paint or draw. Bucket fill: find-area at, use-selection fill. Cut-out: find-area subject, use-selection mask. look outlines it

params.name: matte
params.description: Set by find-area's subject or refine.

label: Set artwork
description: Set the title, size (units) or ground: texture (smooth, paper, cold-press, rough, linen, panel) and colour; or crop the artwork to a region or to what a mark shows (fit).

params.name: crop
params.description: Crop to `[x, y, width, height]`; marks move with it.

params.name: fit
params.description: Crop to what this mark or group shows.

label: Set reference
description: Set the reference picture to recreate or trace: shown over the artwork at its opacity, seen by look (reference: false hides it) and compare; never exported.

params.name: image
params.description: A PNG or JPEG: an absolute file path, a content address, or the picture itself as `data:image/png;base64,…`.

params.name: frame
params.description: `[x, y, width, height]`; fitted to the artwork when absent.

label: Undo
description: Take back your last steps (an agent: its run's) as a new change; with run, that agent run's steps; with by, that author's steps outside a run; with to, all after a version.

params.name: run
params.description: An agent run id from history

params.name: by
params.description: Exact author id from history, for steps outside a run

params.name: to
params.description: A change id from history, or a checkpoint name

label: Use selection
description: Fill or stroke the selection as a mark on a layer, mask the layer to it, or clear it from the layer (by its mask, a layer of grey marks).

params.name: defringe
params.description: mask/clear by a refined edge: clean the old background out of the pictures' edge (default true).

label: Edit a field of this item
description: Change one field: {path: [{field: name} | {item: id} | {key: k} | {cell: {row, column}}], op: set | splice | replace | add | insert | remove | ..., ...its arguments}. Address a collection's items by what they hold, never by position: {path: [{field: name}], op: "upsert-item", match: {field: value}, value: {fields}} updates the one item that matches, else appends one; insert-item and move-to place by at: "end" | {after: id} | {before: id}.

params.name: edit
params.description: The path of the field from the item, and the operation

schema.description:
A field edit: `path` from the record (fields by name, items by id, map entries by key) and `op` with its arguments. Editable paths:
- `name`: set, splice, replace — Name (string)
- `group`: set, splice, replace — Organisational folder; empty for an ungrouped layer. It does not (string)
- `medium`: set, splice, replace — The medium preset that paints this layer's marks, or empty for plain (string)
- `opacity`: set — Opacity (number)
- `visible`: set — Visible (boolean)
- `texture`: set — `0..=1`: how much of the ground's tooth shows through the layer's (number)
- `locked`: set — Held still: the pointer passes through its marks to those beneath (boolean)
- `adjust`: set — Colour and tone adjustments of everything on the layer
- `base`: set — A mask's grey before any mark, `0..=1`: 1 shows all of its layer, (number)
- `invert`: set — A mask that hides where it is light and shows where it is dark (boolean)
- `clip`: set — Clipped to the layer below: it shows only where that layer has paint (boolean)
